name_input: SHRI VINAYAK PACKAGING MACHINE PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export shipment rows found. ImportKey (slug 'shri-vinayak-packaging-machine-private-limited') shows 3063 records, all inbound: e.g. "2026-02-20 | JANGZIN INDUSTRIAL CO.LTD | SHRI VINAYAK PACKAGING MACHINE PRIVATE LIMITED | ITEM NO. JN-740 SEMI-AUTO STRAPPING MACHINE ... | Taichung, TAIWAN | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | 84224000 | 7649733" — origin China/Taiwan, destination India in every row seen (5 of 5 visible rows inbound). Second slug 'shri-vinayak-packaging-machine-pvt-ltd' likewise shows only inbound rows: "2022-10-23 | ZHEJIANG DINGYE MACHINERY CO.,LTD | SHRI VINAYAK PACKAGING MACHINE PVT. LTD. | SEALING MACHINE | Ningbo, China | Nhava Sheva, India | 842203 | NJBN3BCH2C00". No outbound B/L, no foreign buyer, no destination country outside India in any row observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found in accessible sources. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'Connection refused' for all queries, so no domestic-supply pages could be retrieved; volza, eximpedia, trademo returned HTTP 403 and importgenius returned a JavaScript challenge — no data obtained from them. Domestic supply therefore unverified, not disproven.
note: Company is real and active in Indian customs data, but strictly as an IMPORTER/distributor of packaging and sealing machines (HS 842230/842240) sourced from Hualian Machinery Group, Hangzhou Top Well, Jangzin Industrial, Zhejiang Dingye. Declared HS 842240 matches the goods actually traded (packaging/sealing machinery) — no HS correction needed. Rule 5: no trace of supply shipments found on either side — no export records and no verifiable domestic supply evidence; the only confirmed activity is inbound purchasing, which is not a supply record. Role is best classified as trader/distributor (import-and-resell), not manufacturer. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached. Registry/catalogue pages deliberately not used as evidence.
